target_wire_policy.success: Preserve route-specific envelopes (ApiResponse<T> or direct RAG/vector result), System.Text.Json Web camelCase, exact enum numeric shape; unchanged success routes.
target_wire_policy.non_2xx_format: RFC9457 ProblemDetails, standard fields type/title/status (detail/instance optional) and extensions code, correlationId; validation errors extension only for safe field names.

required_extensions.correlationId: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, nonzero; validated server-generated W3C trace identifier or fresh opaque random ID

target_wire_policy.status_consistency: actual HTTP status authoritative; ProblemDetails.status must match transmitted status; success envelope statusCode must match actual HTTP status
target_wire_policy.error_security: Do not return stack traces, tokens, document contents, question text, database/query details or private instance URI.
target_wire_policy.all_http_failures: including MVC controller errors, [ApiController] validation, auth failures, middleware exceptions, notfound and rate limits
target_wire_policy.compatibility_policy: No default legacy tolerance in new SDK; server normalization must be demonstrated in isolated integration fixtures before A2 importer or UI cutover.
target_wire_policy.code_validation_note: Anchored regular expression with literal escaped dot, applied to the entire code string. Syntax alone is insufficient: SDK maps only an explicit local allowlist and never logs untrusted remote code.

typed_not_found_target.resource_absent: API document GET/{id:guid} and GET/{id:guid}/details must return HTTP 404 application/problem+json with code=document.not_found ONLY when that document ID truly does not exist within the authorized scope.
typed_not_found_target.route_missing: Unmatched API route must return HTTP 404 application/problem+json with code=route.not_found, not document.not_found; do not reveal whether an unauthorized document exists.
typed_not_found_target.proxy_or_untrusted_404: A 404 lacking authenticated expected API-origin ProblemDetails, correct content-type, matching status, validated correlation ID, or allowlisted document.not_found is not resource absence; never map it to null.
typed_not_found_target.sdk_mapping: Only GetDocumentAsync/GetDocumentDetailsAsync map verified HTTP 404 + typed document.not_found from the trusted origin to null; wrong route, proxy, generic http.not_found and mismatched payload throw KnowledgeHubHttpRequestException with safe metadata. Other SDK methods always throw on HTTP 404.
typed_not_found_target.status_code_compatibility: Changing the server error extension code is a future API wire-contract change under CR/SPEC-02; must be implemented and tested before nullable SDK behavior is enabled.

404 with spoofed code on nontrusted origin -> exception
authorized-but-hidden document -> fail closed without revealing existence

shared_transport_design.reuse: one internal KnowledgeHubHttpTransport with shared cancellation, timeout, auth pass-through, serialization, error classification, correlation and resource disposal; cannot be public circular facade It also implements bounded response byte-count and JSON collection/depth validation before DTO creation on all 22 operations and on error responses.
shared_transport_design.ownership: host owns HttpClient; SDK disposes requests and responses only
shared_transport_design.per_client_constructor: (HttpClient httpClient, KnowledgeHubHttpClientOptions options); HttpClient supplied by host and NEVER disposed
shared_transport_design.DI_optional: Integrators may register named/typed clients; no mandatory Microsoft.Extensions.* dependency in SDK; no static singleton or auto service-provider creation
shared_transport_design.configuration: Host owns absolute HTTP(S) BaseAddress, authentication, nonredirecting primary handler (AllowAutoRedirect=false) and request identity; HTTPS required for non-loopback, HTTP only loopback; SDK must not blindly log URI, question or body. SDK cannot inspect host redirect handler: integration gate required. Certificate chain and hostname validation must remain enabled on the host-owned handler; TLS bypass is forbidden and requires a real handler integration gate.
shared_transport_design.timeout: SDK-owned TotalRequestTimeout in inclusive 1..2147483647ms range; CancelAfter covers SendAsync and body; caller cancellation wins a tie; host HttpClient.Timeout must be infinite or strictly greater.
shared_transport_design.resource_lifetimes: HttpClient host-owned; request and response sdk-owned
shared_transport_design.host_timeout_compatibility: Reject construction unless TotalRequestTimeout is between 1 and int.MaxValue milliseconds inclusive and HttpClient.Timeout is InfiniteTimeSpan or strictly greater. Validate again before request if host changed its timeout. The SDK never mutates the host-owned HttpClient.

error_contract_target.interface: public interface IKnowledgeHubClientFailure { KnowledgeHubErrorInfo Error { get; } }
error_contract_target.info_record: public sealed record KnowledgeHubErrorInfo(string Code, KnowledgeHubErrorCategory Category, string CorrelationId, HttpStatusCode? HttpStatusCode)
error_contract_target.category_enum: public enum KnowledgeHubErrorCategory { Http = 0, Protocol = 1, Cancellation = 2, Timeout = 3 }
error_contract_target.subclasses: Each of four SDK-owned exception subclasses implements IKnowledgeHubClientFailure and exposes an immutable Error; .NET base catch semantics preserved; no common Exception superclass is possible across HttpRequestException, OperationCanceledException and TimeoutException.

codes.http: http.bad_request, http.unauthorized, http.forbidden, http.not_found, http.conflict, http.rate_limited, http.server_error, http.unexpected_status

error_contract_target.diagnostics: On every SDK-owned exception, include locally produced correlationId from the request context (valid W3C Activity.TraceId or cryptographically random 128-bit fallback), nonzero 32-lowerhex; never trust remote correlation without validation; remote trace is optional context, not authority.
error_contract_target.body_safety: Do not incorporate arbitrary server error codes, headers, body, request URI, sensitive query or invalid remote IDs in exceptions, codes or loggable strings; map server codes from allowlist to stable local codes or fallback. Never buffer or deserialize an unbounded error body; exceeded response cap maps to protocol.response_limit_exceeded.
error_contract_target.timeouts: Require compatible host HttpClient.Timeout in constructor and before first request; if caller token is canceled classify as caller cancellation (wins race); if SDK timeout token fired with caller active classify request.deadline_exceeded; all other cancellations are request.cancelled_unknown. Never silently override HttpClient.Timeout.
error_contract_target.no_new_category_implicit: Additional families/codes require CR and tests; new stable codes can be additive (MINOR) if all consumers handle unknown codes. REV-003 proposes protocol.response_limit_exceeded in the existing Protocol category; it is an additive code requiring maintainer approval under MINOR versioning.
error_contract_target.normalization_first: SDK integration deferred until all server error paths use the approved ProblemDetails wire target
error_contract_target.resource_absence_error_mapping: Server document.not_found and route.not_found are typed API wire codes; SDK may return null only for the first on two reads. Others map to safe HTTP error family http.not_found; never concatenate an arbitrary remote code.

timeout_arbitration.finite_sdk_budget: Require TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1) <= TotalRequestTimeout <= TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(int.MaxValue) (2147483647ms). Reject 0, negative, infinite, fractional sub-millisecond and larger budgets at constructor with ArgumentOutOfRangeException/ArgumentException. Within the bound, CancellationTokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan) can be used for the SDK-owned request+stream deadline; no silent clamping.
timeout_arbitration.host_client_timeout_requirement: HttpClient.Timeout == Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan OR HttpClient.Timeout > TotalRequestTimeout; reject otherwise with ArgumentException naming the invalid configuration before requests.
timeout_arbitration.unexpected_cancel_classification: If SDK budget has not expired and caller did not cancel, map to KnowledgeHubRequestCanceledException (request.cancelled_unknown), never falsely to request.deadline_exceeded.
future_runtime_cases: Caller token canceled during stream -> cancellation category
SDK budget expires during body stream -> timeout category
TotalRequestTimeout 0.5ms / host infinite -> configuration rejected before SendAsync
TotalRequestTimeout 2147483647ms / host infinite -> accepted (timer boundary checked)
TotalRequestTimeout 2147483648ms / host infinite -> configuration rejected before SendAsync
timeout_arbitration.validation_portability: Portable conservative bound across .NET implementations. Do not claim to support UInt32.MaxValue-1 on all platforms. Constructor rejects invalid budget before any request.

host_redirect_security_policy.host_configuration: Construct host-owned HttpClient with HttpClientHandler/SocketsHttpHandler.AllowAutoRedirect = false; same requirement for named/typed clients and the CorpusImporter after SDK cutover. Never use the default auto-redirecting handler for KnowledgeHub API requests, including GET, POST and authenticated requests.
host_redirect_security_policy.host_setup_source: KnowledgeHub.CorpusImporter/Program.cs uses new HttpClientHandler { AllowAutoRedirect = false } at the verified baseline.
host_redirect_security_policy.sdk_contract: The SDK must reject all received 300..399 responses as non-success, never follow Location, never resend request body and never implement its own redirects. No transparent retry.
host_redirect_security_policy.critical_limitation: An HttpClient supplied to a constructor does NOT expose its primary handler/AllowAutoRedirect. The SDK cannot prove the host disabled redirects from HttpClient alone; a nonredirecting host handler and security test are mandatory pre-cutover gates. Do not falsely claim constructor enforcement. If automatic fail-closed construction is required, a separate approved factory/handler API CR is needed.
host_redirect_security_policy.integration_gate: Before any importer/UI/service cutover, test the real configured host HttpClient against 301/302/303/307/308, including cross-origin 307/308 with POST payload and attacker-controlled Location. Assert zero requests/bodies/credentials delivered to redirected origin; 3xx are reported as safe failures. The test must use the production handler configuration, not only a fake nonredirecting handler.
host_redirect_security_policy.sensitive_data_scope: Corpus documents, private RAG questions, credentials, authorization headers and metadata payloads; do not echo Location or response body in exceptions or logs.

base_address_requirements.constructor: Require non-null absolute HttpClient.BaseAddress with scheme http or https, no UserInfo, Query or Fragment; reject at construction with ArgumentException rather than allow InvalidOperationException on first relative send. Recheck before first request if the host mutates its BaseAddress.
base_address_requirements.transport_confidentiality: Only HTTPS is permitted for a non-loopback host; cleartext HTTP is restricted to loopback (same as existing CorpusImporter/Program.cs). Reuse the approved host address; do not replace or mutate it.
base_address_requirements.relative_route_resolution: Treat the recorded /api/... routes as API route identities; construct relative request paths without an initial slash and resolve against a normalized trailing-slash BaseAddress, preserving an explicitly configured API path prefix. Do not silently discard a reverse-proxy prefix or authorize a new origin.
base_address_requirements.source_baseline: KnowledgeHub.CorpusImporter/Program.cs checks configured URL; KnowledgeHub.CorpusImporter/Services/CorpusImporter.cs checks BaseAddress non-null.
tests: HTTPS absolute with path prefix -> correct final request URI

client_http_v1.nullable_not_found_contract: Only two listed document reads may return null after exact RFC9457 HTTP 404 ProblemDetails at the configured trusted origin, with status 404, code=document.not_found and valid correlationId. Generic 404, missing route/proxy 404, malformed body or unallowlisted code MUST throw; no status-only 404-to-null fallback in the new SDK. No API normalization, no SDK cutover.

host_tls_validation_policy.transport_policy: Use HTTPS for every non-loopback API origin. Keep platform TLS chain and DNS hostname validation active; permit a host private CA only if explicitly trusted by the host OS/organization. Reject invalid, expired, self-signed-untrusted, or wrong-host certificates.
forbidden_bypasses: ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback returning true without full chain and hostname validation
nonproduction trust-all handlers or automatic unsafe fallback when TLS fails
host_tls_validation_policy.handler_observability_limit: An SDK constructor receiving a host-supplied HttpClient cannot inspect TLS validation callbacks or trust settings. HTTPS URI checking is not a TLS security guarantee. No unsupported claim of constructor enforcement.
host_tls_validation_policy.host_ownership: The integrator owns HttpClient/SocketsHttpHandler or HttpClientHandler, DI registration, trusted roots and certificate policy. The SDK must not silently alter or replace the host handler.
host_tls_validation_policy.cutover_gate: Before importer, MAUI, Avalonia or service cutover, exercise the actual production-equivalent configured handler against trusted HTTPS (success), untrusted self-signed, wrong DNS host and expired certificates (all fail closed). Confirm that no request body, credentials or raw private diagnostics reach the untrusted endpoint; cross-check redirect gate separately.
host_tls_validation_policy.scope: documentation_target_only; SDK and integration tests remain unimplemented

response_resource_limits.scope: new SDK v1 target, not existing server behavior; pending maintainer approval
response_resource_limits.decoded_bytes_meaning: The byte counter is applied to the representation consumed by the JSON decoder, after any host automatic decompression; Content-Length is an optional early rejection only, not authoritative for chunked, compressed or lying responses.
response_resource_limits.enforcement: Use ResponseHeadersRead and a length-limited stream for both success and failure bodies. Count bytes incrementally while reading, then validate JSON depth and top-level/nested result collection counts before materializing untrusted DTOs. Reject oversized/overdeep/too-many-items payloads via safe KnowledgeHubHttpProtocolException with protocol.response_limit_exceeded; dispose response and stream promptly. The SDK total timeout and caller cancellation cover all reads.
response_resource_limits.no_silent_fallback: No truncated success responses, partial data, catch-and-return-empty, automatic pagination or hidden retry; if an existing list or document exceeds the explicit fixed cap, fail closed with a stable protocol error. A pagination/streaming API requires an independently approved versioned CR and server support; not added to the 22 existing routes here.
response_resource_limits.security: No response body, private URI, raw item, Location, tokens or server-controlled text in exception/log. Bound error-body parsing identically and map only allowlisted server codes; an oversized ProblemDetails body is a safe protocol failure, not a trusted error.
acceptance_tests: all 22 routes have explicit decoded-byte caps and error cap
bounded 200 / 201 body at exact cap succeeds when otherwise valid
large chunked stream without Content-Length -> safe failure before overallocating
compressed small wire / large decoded body (decompression bomb) -> decoded cap enforced
oversized HTTP 400 application/problem+json -> safe failure without body in exception
JSON nested deeper than 64 -> bounded protocol failure
4097 list entries or 1025 vector entries -> safe protocol failure before DTO construction
legitimate document bigger than cap -> explicit failure, no silent truncation or invented pagination
caller cancellation and SDK total timeout continue to work during bounded reads
